articles.title: AIS, Form 26AS and Form 16: What Is the Difference?
articles.excerpt: Understand the exact difference between these crucial tax documents to avoid mismatches and defective return notices.
articles.intro: When you file your Income Tax Return, you encounter these three crucial documents. Understanding the difference can help you check your income details properly and drastically reduce the chances of errors.
articles.answer: Rule of Thumb: Form 16 = Salary | Form 26AS = Tax Credits | AIS = All Financial Activity

faqs.q: Is Form 16 the same as AIS?
faqs.a: No. Form 16 is a salary TDS certificate provided directly by your employer. AIS is a broader information statement generated by the Income Tax Department containing your overall financial data.

faqs.q: Is Form 26AS the same as AIS?
faqs.a: No. Form 26AS mainly contains TDS and TCS-related information, while AIS provides much broader information including property, stocks, and high-value transactions.
Yes, absolutely. Salaried employees often have bank interest or mutual fund transactions apart from salary. Reviewing AIS helps identify these additional reported incomes to avoid mismatch notices.

faqs.q: What should I do if Form 16 and Form 26AS do not match?
faqs.a: If the TDS shown in Form 16 is not visible in Form 26AS, do not claim it immediately. Contact your employer or deductor to clarify why the TDS has not been reflected in the government portal.

articles.disclaimer: This article is for general information only. The documents and information required for ITR filing may vary depending on the taxpayer's income sources and circumstances. Always review the applicable records for the relevant assessment year before filing your return.

faqs.q: Do I need to visit your office in Dehradun, or is the process 100% online?
faqs.a: Our entire workflow is **100% paperless and online**. Whether you are in Dehradun, Noida, Delhi, Mumbai, or anywhere in India, you can simply share your documents via WhatsApp or Email, review your computation draft on your phone, and receive your official ITR-V or GST certificate without stepping out.

faqs.q: Why should I reconcile AIS and Form 26AS before filing my Income Tax Return?
faqs.a: The Income Tax Department's automated system cross-checks your ITR against your **Annual Information Statement (AIS)** and **Form 26AS**. Even a small mismatch in bank interest, dividends, stock trading, or TDS can trigger an automated Section 139(9) Defective Return or Section 143(1) demand notice. We reconcile all three documents before filing.

faqs.q: How long does it take to file an ITR or get a new GST Registration?
faqs.a: **Income Tax Returns (ITR)** are typically audited, prepared, and filed within **4 to 24 hours** of receiving complete documents. **New GST Registration** applications are filed within 24 hours, and government GSTIN allotment generally takes **3 to 5 working days** subject to Aadhaar authentication.

faqs.q: Is my financial data and PAN/Aadhaar information kept confidential?
faqs.a: Yes, 100%. We follow strict client data privacy protocols. Your financial statements, Form 16, and identity documents are only used for official government portal filings and are never shared with any third-party marketers or external agencies.

faqs.q: Can you help if I already filed my ITR elsewhere and received a tax notice?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Even if someone else filed your original return, our Notice Defense Desk can review your intimation order, prepare a Revised Return (u/s 139(5)), Rectification Request (u/s 154), or Defective Return response (u/s 139(9)) to resolve the discrepancy.
